messages:
sam_k: heads up — onboarding sampleapp failing on fncall + schema validation. devs hit a parse error when the tool returns a top-level array.
maria: ugh, repro? can you paste the response + schema?
sam_k: yeah. minimal repro:
```json
// model/tool returns this payload as function_output in json mode
[ {
  "id": 1,
  "text": "ok"
} ]
```
schema we register in samplekit: 
```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": { "type": "integer" },
    "text": { "type": "string" }
  },
  "required": ["id","text"]
}
```
maria: so schema expects object but tool returns array — why did this surface now? sampleapp uses the SDK helper that used to coerce single-object arrays into object, right?
alex: parity issue — python helper used to auto-unpack single-element arrays for fncall/json_mode, but JS helper only validates strictly. so Python apps silently worked, JS apps fail.
jin: also saw this with auth/retry loops — if a retry wraps the tool result it becomes stringified JSON in some cases: "[... ]" which makes validation worse. mixing coercion + string-encoding is messy.
sam_k: exact. our samplekit pipeline retries on 5xx and then middleware does `JSON.stringify(result)` before passing to schema validator (old bug). that turned a plain array into a string sometimes.
maria: can we do quick mitigation in sampleapp? options: 1) loosen schema to allow array OR object; 2) update JS helper to mirror Python auto-unpack behavior; 3) ensure retry middleware doesn't stringify.
alex: I'd prefer (3) + (2) as proper fixes. (1) hides the real mismatch. i'll draft a JS helper fix that: if schema.type === 'object' and value is array of length 1 and first elem matches schema, coerce. also add a guard to detect stringified-json and parse it first.
jin: small code sketch — add a util `normalizeFnResult(raw)` that does: if typeof raw === 'string' try JSON.parse, if Array and schema.type==='object' && raw.length===1 -> raw = raw[0].
ci-bot: created issue #3421: "devex: js helper should normalize fncall json + avoid stringify-on-retry" by alex
sam_k: thanks — i'll patch sampleapp to handle this until helper lands. tagging @maria for testcases: please add a unit test that simulates retry double-encode + array return.
maria: on it. i'll also add a small e2e with samplekit CLI using `--json-mode` to ensure parity with python sample.
alex: i'll open the PR today, include changelog and a note about not changing public SDK surface. gonna keep option behind a minor helpers flag so we can ship safer.
sam_k: :thumbsup: thanks all. leaving this thread open until PR merges + sampleapp test passes.
